claims.claim: Get the ultimate gaming experience with this PlayStation 4 Pro.
claims.evidence: Witness report does not show any readable console brand/model; only boxes labeled “Wireless Controller” and a white console/stand with no clear brand/model readable.
No performance/testing evidence shown (no power-on, no game running, no specs visible).

risks.risk: Console identity may not be PS4 Pro (could be another console or a non-PS4 unit), so pricing based on PS4 Pro would be wrong.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console’s model/serial label (e.g., CUH-7xxx for PS4 Pro) and the front/back ports showing the exact unit.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unidentified/possibly different PlayStation console bundle with unknown condition and no confirmed PS4 Pro model.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-functional or incomplete (buttons/sticks/triggers/pairing/vibration not confirmed).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing each controller powering on, pairing to the console, and working inputs (analog movement + trigger press + vibration if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price as controllers with unknown functionality (treat as not guaranteed working).

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have faults (overheating, disc drive issues, corrupted system).
risks.proof: A clip showing the console powering on to the home screen and (if applicable) loading a game or running a system menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested / possibly faulty until power-on is demonstrated.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/cables or incomplete box contents (chargers, HDMI, power cable, USB cable, manuals).
risks.proof: A full laid-out photo of every included accessory with close-ups of cable ends and any included items.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete bundle (missing accessories assumed possible).

risks.risk: Network/account lock or connectivity issues (Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth not confirmed; possible account restrictions).
risks.proof: A clip showing Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth settings working and successful connection (and account status if any prompts appear).

risks.risk: Condition issues (scratches, dents, worn ports, damaged controller shells) that affect resale value.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the console exterior, controller shells, and all ports (HDMI, USB, power) plus any visible damage.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case cosmetic/port wear for used electronics.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console model/serial label (model code visible) and a photo of the console front/back ports.
Video showing the console powering on and reaching the home screen (or system menu).
Video showing both controllers pairing and responding to inputs (sticks + triggers + buttons).
Full photo of all included accessories/cables (power, HDMI, charging/USB, manuals) laid out clearly.
Photos/clip of Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth settings showing successful connection (if applicable).
Close-ups of console and controller physical condition, especially ports and any damage.
response.reason: The witness confirms only “Wireless Controller” boxes and a generic white console/stand with no readable PS4 Pro identifiers, and there is no power-on or controller functionality proof. Without model/working confirmation, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
